Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) for a project under the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow, with a total of 1 vacancy announced under the advertisement number IITD/IRD/255/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications via email is 09-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BS/MS/BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree with at least 55% marks along with passing the NET/GATE test in Physics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years. Age relaxation of up to 5 years is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Women, and Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Candidates need to download the specified form and email it along with necessary documents to the designated professor.

faq.question: Q7. How much salary will be provided for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary/stipend as per CSIR Guidelines established for the project.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi JRF?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to this Junior Research Fellow project position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official IRD website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec to download the recruitment notification and application form.
